title: The Number of Full Rounds You Have Played
summary: In a chess tournament where a new round begins every 15 minutes, starting from 00:00 and ending at 23:45, you are provided with your login and logout times.
statement: In a chess tournament where a new round begins every 15 minutes, starting from 00:00 and ending at 23:45, you are provided with your login and logout times. Calculate the number of full rounds you have played. If your logout time is earlier than your login time, consider the rounds from login to midnight and then from midnight to logout.
constraints: Times use valid 24-hour HH:MM format and are unequal.
If logout is earlier than login, the session crosses midnight; count only rounds fully contained in the session.
hints: Convert both clock strings to minutes after midnight and add one day to an overnight logout.
Round login up to the first round boundary and logout down to the last completed boundary.
Subtract the resulting quarter-hour indices, clamping at zero.
Those boundaries exclude both partial edge rounds and retain every full interior 15-minute interval exactly once.
editorial: Those boundaries exclude both partial edge rounds and retain every full interior 15-minute interval exactly once.

tests.explanation: Only the 09:45 through 10:00 round is fully contained.
The overnight ten-hour interval contains forty complete quarter-hour rounds.
